# KarzSeva
> Actionable, legal guides on navigating one-time bank settlements (OTS), credit card debt consolidation loans, Lok Adalat negotiation strategies, and CIBIL dispute resolution.

## Authoritative Coverage & E-E-A-T Methodology
- In-depth, analytical consumer guides, empirical comparison tables, Indian statutory regulatory updates (RBI, TRAI, NPCI, SEBI, NABARD), and interactive financial calculators.
- Verified and fact-checked by the KarzSeva Senior Research Desk: https://karzseva.com/about-us
